_note: Silhouette of the free body: MakeHuman (CC0) shape targets added to base.obj, with their dose. Each key is the path of the file under makehuman/data/targets in the MakeHuman repository; build.py downloads them into the "targets" folder next to base.obj, at the same path. The first five give a slim young woman; the next seven give the proportions of game characters (long legs, short and narrow torso, rolled-in shoulders, long and thin neck), tuned on measurements: shoulder at 139 cm from the ground, hip at 100 cm, half-width of the skin at the top of the shoulders around 15.5 cm and at the waist around 8.3 cm. Changing a dose or adding a target changes the silhouette; run build.py again.
